summary: Members explain their choice of {portrait} in terms of who will recognize it.
realLife: In discussing California's innovation dollar, committee members favored a particular Steve Jobs image because they thought the public would recognize him more readily.
gates: Members are comparing portraits intended to identify the same person.
inGame: needs: portrait alternatives and recognition rationale.

turns.what: A blind viewing favors the other portrait.
turns.pulledBy: Viewers fail to identify the first drawing.

turns.what: Members recognize the face at full size alone.
turns.pulledBy: A reduced proof obscures the features.
turns.writesBack: The artist gets a request for a coin-size study.
